children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may test a support at $7.54-3/4 per bushel, a break below which could open the way toward $7.45-1/4.
The contract failed twice to break a resistance at $7.89-3/4. The failure, along with the current fall, suggests the formation of a flat or double-top.
The drop may end around $7.54-3/4, if the pattern turns out to be a flat, or extend toward $7.28, if a double-top is forming.
Immediate resistance is at $7.71-1/4, a break above which could lead to a gain into $7.81-1/2 to $7.89-3/4 range. On the daily chart, the uptrend would remain intact despite the current correction.
Wave pattern indicates the development of a wave 4, which will be reversed by an upward wave 5.
